relationships.subject: PAC1 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the PAC1 receptor by PACAP leads to the activation of the adenylyl cyclase enzyme, which in turn leads to the production of cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) and the activation of PKA [99].

relationships.subject: PACAP
relationships.evidence_quote: PACAP binds with high affinity to all three receptors, while VIP binds with high affinity to VPAC1 and VPAC2 receptors and has a thousand fold lower affinity for the PAC1 receptor compared to PACAP

relationships.subject: Lu AG09222
relationships.evidence_quote: the PACAP ligand mAb, Lu AG09222 significantly reduced the number of monthly migraine days over placebo in a phase 2 clinical trial

key_findings: Review: PACAP and VIP are emerging migraine targets beyond CGRP; PAC1 mAb AMG 301 showed no benefit while PACAP mAb Lu AG09222 reduced monthly migraine days.
PACAP pathway appears independent of CGRP pathway in rodent models.
